statement.p: Approximate f_{x}(3,5) using the contour diagram of f(x, y) shown below.

static.solution: f_{x}, we want to find a difference quotient f_{x} \approx \frac{f(x_0+h,y_0) - f(x_0,y_0)}{h}. Here, we have f(3,5) \approx 8, and f(6,5) \approx 10. Thus, we can take f_{x} \approx \frac{f(6,5) - f(3,5)}{3} = \frac{10 - 8}{3} = 0.666667. Of course, we could take h \lt 0 and use the contour f = 10 as well, or average the two results.
